content: Yɑkɔbu wi bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Isireli, win bibun yĩsɑ wee. Rubɛni, kɑ Simɛɔ, kɑ Lefi, kɑ Yudɑ, kɑ Isɑkɑri, kɑ Sɑbuloni,
kɑ Dɑnu, kɑ Yosɛfu, kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ, kɑ Nɛfitɑli, kɑ Gɑdi, kɑ Asɛɛ.
Be bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yudɑn bibu, berɑ Eri kɑ Onɑni, kɑ Selɑ. Ben mɛrowɑ Suɑ, Kɑnɑniɡii. Eri, Yudɑn bii ɡbiikoo wi, u kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ, mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ u ɡu.
Tɑmɑɑ Yudɑn biiɡii kurɔwɑ u nùn Perɛsi kɑ Serɑki mɑruɑ. Mɑ Yudɑn bibu kpuro bɑ kuɑ tɔmbu nɔɔbu.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Perɛsin bibu, berɑ Hɛsironi, kɑ Hɑmulu.
Serɑkin bibɑ mɑɑ Simiri, kɑ Etɑni, kɑ Hemɑni, kɑ Kɑlikoli, kɑ sere Dɑrɑ. Be kpuro bɑ kuɑwɑ mi tɔmbu nɔɔbu.
Kɑɑmiwɑ u Akɑni mɑrɑ. Akɑni wiyɑ u Isirelibɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru kpɛ̃ɛ kɔ̃sɑ ye u kuɑn sɔ̃. U yɑ̃nu suɑ ni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ bu kpeerɑsiɑ mɑm mɑm.
Etɑnin biiwɑ Asɑriɑ.
Be bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Hɛsironin bibu, berɑ Yerɑmɛɛli, kɑ Rɑmu, kɑ Kɑlɛbu, wi bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Kelubɑi.
Rɑmuwɑ u Aminɑdɑbu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Aminɑdɑbu u mɑɑ Nɑsoni mɑrɑ, wi u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn wiruɡii.
Nɑsoni wiyɑ u Sɑlumɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sɑlumɑ u mɑɑ Boɑsi mɑrɑ.
Boɑsiwɑ u Yobɛdi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yobɛdi u mɑɑ Isɑi mɑrɑ.
Eliɑbuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Isɑin bii ɡbiikoo. Mɑ Abinɑdɑbu u sɑ̃ɑ yiruse. Mɑ Sɑmɑ u sɑ̃ɑ itɑse.
Mɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli u sɑ̃ɑ nnɛse. Mɑ Rɑdɑi u sɑ̃ɑ nɔɔbuse.
Mɑ Osɛmu u sɑ̃ɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑse. Mɑ Dɑfidi u sɑ̃ɑ nɔɔbɑ yiruse.
Ben sesubɑ Seruyɑ kɑ Abiɡɑli. Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Seruyɑn bibu, berɑ Abisɑi kɑ Yoɑbu kɑ Asɑɛli. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ mi, be itɑ.
Amɑsɑn mɛrowɑ Abiɡɑli. Win tundowɑ mɑɑ Yetɛɛ, Isimɛɛli.
Kɑlɛbu, Hɛsironin bii u tɔn durɔbu itɑ mɑrɑ kɑ win kurɔ Asubɑ. Berɑ Yesɛɛ kɑ Sobɑbu kɑ Aɑdoni. U mɑɑ kɑ Yeriɔtu mɑrɑ.
Ye Asubɑ u ɡu, mɑ Kɑlɛbu u Efɑrɑtɑ suɑ kurɔ. Mɑ Efɑrɑtɑ wi, u nùn Huri mɑruɑ.
Huri wiyɑ u Uri mɑrɑ. Mɑ Uri u mɑɑ Bɛsɑlɛli mɑrɑ.
Yen biru, ye Hɛsironi u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɑtɑ, yerɑ u Mɑkiri, Gɑlɑdin tundon bii suɑ kurɔ. Mɑ u nùn Seɡubu mɑruɑ.
Seɡubu wiyɑ u Yɑiri mɑrɑ. Yɑiri wi, u wusu wɑwɑ yɛndɑ itɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ.
Adɑmɑ Gesuribɑ kɑ Siriɡibu bɑ Yɑirin wuu si wɔri bɑ mwɑ kɑ Kenɑtin wusu kɑ sin bɑru kpɑɑnu kpuro. Su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wusu wɑtɑ. Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wuu si sɔɔ kpuro, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Mɑkiri Gɑlɑdin tundon debuminu.
Hɛsironi, Abiɑn durɔn ɡɔɔn biru, Kɑlɛbu u mɑɑ kɑ Efɑrɑtɑ mɛnnɑ mɑ u nùn bii tɔn durɔ mɑruɑ wi bɑ sokumɔ Asuri. Asuri wiyɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Tekoɑɡibun sikɑdo.
Yerɑmɛɛli, Hɛsironin bii ɡbiikoon bibɑ, Rɑmu, kɑ Bunɑ, kɑ Orɛni, kɑ Osɛmu, kɑ Akiyɑ. Rɑmuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben ɡbiikoo.
Yerɑmɛɛli wi, u mɑɑ kurɔ ɡoo suɑ wi bɑ sokumɔ Atɑrɑ, Onɑmun mɛro.
Rɑmu, Yerɑmɛɛlin bii ɡbiikoon bibɑ Mɑɑsi, kɑ Yɑmini, kɑ Ekɛɛ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Onɑmun bibu, berɑ Sɑmɑi, kɑ Yɑdɑ. Be bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɑin bibu, berɑ Nɑdɑbu kɑ Abisuri.
Abisurin kurɔn yĩsirɑ Abihɑili. Wiyɑ u nùn Akubɑni kɑ Mɔlidi mɑruɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Nɑdɑbun bibu, berɑ Selɛdi kɑ Apɑimu. Selɛdi wi, u ǹ bii mɑrɑ u kɑ ɡu.
Apɑimuwɑ u Yisei mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yisei u Sesɑni mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sesɑni u mɑɑ Alɑi mɑrɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yɑdɑ, Sɑmɑin wɔnɔn bibu, berɑ Yetɛɛ kɑ Yonɑtɑm. Yetɛɛ wi, u ǹ bii mɑrɑ u kɑ ɡu.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yonɑtɑm bibu, berɑ Pelɛti kɑ Sɑsɑ. Beni kpurowɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yerɑmɛɛlin bibun bweseru.
Sesɑni u ǹ bii tɔn durɔbu mɑrɑ. Bii tɔn kurɔbu tɔnɑwɑ u mɑrɑ. Sesɑni wi, u Eɡibitiɡii ɡoo mɔ yoo, wi bɑ rɑ soku Yɑrɑ.
Mɑ Sesɑni u win bii tɔn kurɔ suɑ u Yɑrɑ win yoo Eɡibitiɡii wi wɛ̃ u suɑ kurɔ. Mɑ u nùn Atɑi mɑruɑ.
Atɑiwɑ u Nɑtɑni mɑrɑ. Mɑ Nɑtɑni u mɑɑ Sɑbɑdi mɑrɑ.
Sɑbɑdiwɑ u Efilɑli mɑrɑ. Mɑ Efilɑli u Obɛdi mɑrɑ.
Obɛdiwɑ u Yehu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yehu u mɑɑ Asɑriɑ mɑrɑ.
Asɑriɑwɑ u Hɑlɛsi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Hɑlɛsi u mɑɑ Elɑsɑ mɑrɑ.
Elɑsɑwɑ u Sisimɑi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sisimɑi u mɑɑ Sɑlumu mɑrɑ.
Sɑlumuwɑ u Yekɑmiɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yekɑmiɑ u Elisɑmɑ mɑrɑ.
Kɑlɛbu, Yerɑmɛɛlin mɔɔn bii ɡbiikoowɑ Mɛsɑ, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Sifun tundo kɑ Mɑresɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Heboronin tundo.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Heboronin bibu, berɑ Kore, kɑ Tɑpuɑ kɑ Rekɛmu, kɑ Semɑ.
Semɑwɑ u Rɑkɑmu, Yɔɔkɑmun tundo mɑrɑ. Rekɛmuwɑ u mɑɑ Sɑmmɑi mɑrɑ.
Sɑmmɑiwɑ u Mɑoni mɑrɑ. Mɑ Mɑoni u Bɛti Suri mɑrɑ.
Efɑ, Kɑlɛbun kurɔ ɡoo, wiyɑ u Hɑrɑni, kɑ Mɔsɑ, kɑ Gɑsɛsi mɑrɑ. Hɑrɑni wi, u mɑɑ bii mɑrɑ mɑ u nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Gɑsɛsi.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yɑdɑin bibu, berɑ Reɡɛmu kɑ Yotɑmu, kɑ Gesɑni, kɑ Pelɛti, kɑ Efɑ, kɑ Sɑɑfu.
Mɑɑkɑ, Kɑlɛbun kurɔ ɡoowɑ u Sebɛɛ kɑ Tirɑnɑ mɑrɑ.
Yen biru u mɑɑ Sɑɑfu, Mɑdimɑnɑn tundo mɑrɑ, kɑ Sefɑ, Mɑkibenɑ kɑ Gibeɑn tundo. Kɑlɛbu u bii tɔn kurɔ mɑrɑ. Wiyɑ bɑ mɔ̀ Akusɑ.
Win kurɔ Efɑrɑtɑn bii ɡbiikoowɑ Huri. Bibu itɑwɑ Huri u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Sobɑli wi u sɑ̃ɑ Kiriɑti Yɑrimun kɑbɑ wuko,
kɑ Sɑlumɑ, Bɛtelehɛmun kɑbɑ wuko, kɑ Hɑrɛfu, Bɛti Gedɛɛn kɑbɑ wuko.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sobɑli, Kiriɑti Yɑrimun kɑbɑ wukon bweseru, berɑ Hɑroeɡibu, kɑ Mɛnuhɔtuɡibun sukum,
kɑ bwese kɛri yi yi wɑ̃ɑ Kiriɑti Yɑrimuɔ. Yiyɑ Yetɛɛbɑ, kɑ Putibɑ, kɑ Sumɑtibɑ, kɑ Misirɑibɑ. Bwese kɛri yin min diyɑ Soreɑɡibu kɑ Ɛsitɑoliɡibu bɑ yɑrɑ.
Sɑlumɑn min diyɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɡibu bɑ yɑrɑ kɑ Nɛtofɑɡibu, kɑ Atɑrɔtu Bɛti Yoɑbuɡibu, kɑ Mɑnɑhɑtiɡibun sukum, kɑ Soreɑɡibu,
kɑ be bɑ rɑ tirenu yore bɑ kɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yɑbɛsiɔ. Berɑ Tireɑtiɡibu kɑ Simɛɑtiɡibu kɑ Sukɑtiɡibu. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Kenibɑ be bɑ yɑrɑ Hɑmɑtin bweserun di wi u sɑ̃ɑ Rekɑbun bweserun sikɑdo.
Dɑfidin bibun bweserun tɔ̃kɑ
